note: Confirmed defects only. See tools/defect_register.py for why this is not a commit log and why the density is not the signal.

records.subject: fix(stonedesk): the AI panel priced labour without being told what it could not price
records.summary: The timesheet AI panel priced labour from raw rows, so unrated rows reached the model as bare hours and the cost estimate carried no exclusion note

records.subject: fix(tests): two suite runs at once made every probe restore the wrong file
records.summary: Concurrent suite runs made every mutating probe restore the OTHER run's mutation: it stripped a production corruption guard from sairnvet.html repeatedly while reporting "restored byte-identical: True"

records.subject: fix(sairnvet): a throw mid-hydrate suppressed every later backup for the session, invisibly -- and a synced consult still said it could not travel
records.summary: A throw mid-hydration left svSyncSuppressed true, silencing every later server write for the whole session, with the surrounding .catch swallowing the evidence

records.subject: fix(tests): the platform wrapper test was crashing, and a COMMENT counted as a report
records.summary: tests/sairn_storage_wrapper_honesty.js crashed on ReferenceError inside the SAIRNmechanical block, so every later block -- stonedesk and sairnvet -- never ran while the file was cited as platform-wide coverage

records.subject: fix(tests): the platform wrapper test was crashing, and a COMMENT counted as a report
records.summary: the same file's speaks regex ran over raw source, so a CODE COMMENT mentioning toast satisfied the assertion that no app has a silent write wrapper

records.subject: fix(tools): a could-not-tell is exit 3, and one checker is held back rather than silenced
records.summary: local_only_collection_check returned 1 for a real finding AND for "could not read this app", so it reported local-only 0 in all eighteen apps and still exited non-zero

records.subject: fix(sairndental): a dropped socket, a hang and a partial response were all silent
records.summary: Three source assertions matched what came AFTER the guard rather than its position, so if(false && dntIsUnconfirmed(...)) left them green

records.subject: fix(sairndental): a dropped socket, a hang and a partial response were all silent
records.summary: A mutation control was anchored on a line two writers share verbatim, so it reported ANCHOR-2 and silently probed nothing

records.subject: fix(sairndental): a dropped socket, a hang and a partial response were all silent
records.summary: A dropped socket produced NO toast at all, because a rejection never reaches a .then(ok => ...) handler -- and two callers attach none, so it was an unhandled rejection

records.subject: fix(sairndental): a dropped socket, a hang and a partial response were all silent
records.summary: A hung write never settled and there was no timeout anywhere on the path, so it was indistinguishable from not having clicked

records.subject: fix(sairndental): a dropped socket, a hang and a partial response were all silent
records.summary: A partial response counted as success and CLEARED the unconfirmed flag, letting hydration overwrite the local copy

records.subject: fix(sairnvet,tools): the hang was the silent one -- both recorded mechanisms were wrong
records.summary: A hung server backup was completely silent: no timeout anywhere, so svData() never settled, the saved===null warning never printed, and the record stayed on one device with nothing saying so

records.subject: fix(sairnvet,tools): the hang was the silent one -- both recorded mechanisms were wrong
records.summary: recordSvSharedTopics() wrote shared_knowledge fire-and-forget with no timeout, so a hung AI-context write was unobservable at the call site

records.subject: fix(sairnvet,tools): the hang was the silent one -- both recorded mechanisms were wrong
records.summary: write_path_fault_scan.py only recognised a literal .catch(, so the two-argument .then(ok, err) form in svPushOne and dntPushOne -- the fixes for this very hazard -- were reported as the hazard

records.subject: fix(sairnmechanical): a dead second mechEsc, found by the first real run of check 27
records.summary: Two mechEsc definitions in one script block: the later hoisted over the earlier, so an edit to the wrong one would silently reach no call site -- in an HTML escaper

records.subject: fix(sairnvet): a demo seed was pushing invented records to the live server, including the controlled-substance register
records.summary: Lazy demo seeding reached the LIVE server on a fresh device: opening the controlled-substance panel wrote invented drug balances with invented vet names into the real DEA-relevant register, and hydration is additive-only with no delete path

records.subject: fix(sairnvet): a peer-consult photo cannot fit the row, so it is not sent -- and not sent silently
records.summary: A peer-consult photo is a base64 JPEG against a 64KB CHECK, so every photo consult write was rejected and surfaced only as a console warning

records.subject: fix(sairngrounds,tools): forty-three writes, no timeout, and a weather message said otherwise
records.summary: 43 server writes with no timeout on any path: a hung fetch never returns from the await, so grdData's catch never runs and the toast naming what failed to sync never fires at all

records.subject: fix(sairngrounds,tools): forty-three writes, no timeout, and a weather message said otherwise
records.summary: cmSavePoints() read nothing from its push while all three callers toasted Point captured unconditionally, so a course point that never reached the server was announced as captured

records.subject: fix(sairngrounds,tools): forty-three writes, no timeout, and a weather message said otherwise
records.summary: write_path_fault_scan.py timeout column matched user-facing STRINGS and counted read-path timeouts, reporting an app with zero timeouts as bounded -- the optimistic direction

records.subject: fix(sairngrounds,tools): forty-three writes, no timeout, and a weather message said otherwise
records.summary: the same scan counted writes inside COMMENTS and classified elements of an awaited Promise.all as fire-and-forget, over-reporting 5 safe sites in sairngrounds and 2 phantom sites in other apps

records.subject: fix(nav_panel_check): it reported PASS on two apps whose panel system it could not see
records.summary: nav_panel_check reported RESULT:PASS on two apps whose panel system it could not see -- 32 containers invisible, vouching for what it had not looked at

records.subject: fix(sairndental): a refused vendor write showed success and the next sync erased it
records.summary: A refused vendor write showed a success toast and the next sync silently replaced the edit -- a negotiated discount, so it changes what the practice pays

records.subject: fix(tools): the register pointed at commits that never existed on main
records.summary: The defect register recorded pre-rebase SHAs, so records pointed at commits that never existed on main and the one promoted report-only checker was permanently red in every clone

records.subject: fix(tools): the register pointed at commits that never existed on main
records.summary: defect_register --check ran its vocabulary validation after a continue, so a record with an unresolvable SHA stopped having its method, layer and severity checked at all

records.subject: fix(tools): the second half of the sweep -- three checkers reported clean while scanning nothing
records.summary: report_only_checks.py reported a clean platform after scanning zero apps: an empty target list skipped the per-app loop entirely, so 132 checker runs could vanish into a report byte-identical to a clean sweep

records.subject: fix(tests): narrow the delegation hop to catch bodies -- and the hole it does not close
records.summary: the wrapper check asked whether a wrapper speaks ANYWHERE, so silencing sairnvet st()'s write-failure catch left its backup-hook catch talking and the check green -- the delegation narrowing alone did not close this
